model.admission: One willing perceived target within120ft/LoE and one distinguishable faction ID. NEW static fixture permits a synthetic faction relationship, explicitly labeled; real membership, office and actual institutional services still need their own authority.
model.standing: On successful resolution write the selected target/faction current standing to the established maximum +3. Append a spell-caused standing event with old value/version. Do not erase conduct, debts, sanctions or history; do not grant membership, office, alliance or Incarnate invocation. Later real misconduct can lower standing normally.

significantBenefit.classification: NEW spell-local benefit, not an institution resource or copied faction service
significantBenefit.grant: Create one finite entitlement for this target/faction pair if none was ever granted or consumed. A new legitimate externally granted entitlement would require its own source record; recasting cannot manufacture one.
significantBenefit.key: targetID:factionID:FactionReserve-40; durable across source endings, replacement, load/save and recasts
significantBenefit.activation: Target spends one real Action while alive, willing and standing with that faction is currently+3. It gains40 temporary HP under the shared nonadditive temporary-HP rule. Consume entitlement at legal activation even if a stronger temporary-HP pool means no increase. No RP recovery or healing.
significantBenefit.window: Entitlement expires at initial successful resolution+86400000ms; actual granted temporaryHP expires at that same deadline or earlier depletion/death. No clock refresh on recast.
significantBenefit.source: rank9 ongoing benefit expression after instantaneous standing update; no concentration
significantBenefit.suppression: Only unconsumed entitlement activation/remaining granted magical tempHP is unavailable while covered; consumed/depleted counts stay consumed, deadline continues. Resumption exposes only remaining pool, never original40.
significantBenefit.revocation: Standing below+3 disables unconsumed activation and suppresses remaining benefit until+3 or expiry; standing restoration cannot refill it.

model.repeatAndDeath: New paid casts may set current standing to+3 again but do not erase intervening misconduct or reset the unique entitlement. Completed standing updates are not reversed by dispelling the benefit. Death ends remaining tempHP and entitlement with real corpse/equipment unchanged.
model.fixture: TEST-DD11-WARDENS ledger starts standing-1, nonmember, no office, conduct event c1 retained, no prior FactionReserve grant. An independent second fixture starts +2 and has already consumed the same keyed entitlement.
